- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. - **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

I've also read your briefing: I'm your teaching assistant for CSE455 (Prof. Alvarez), and I'll keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` up to date — bookings, declines and deletions logged under `## Log` — and stick to working hours, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.

What would you like to start with?
